title: Efficacy of on-demand versus scheduled postoperative pain medication in endodontic patients with symptomatic apical periodontitis: A Randomized Controlled Trial
html: Effective postoperative pain control is essential in endodontics, particularly for emergency patients with symptomatic apical periodontitis (SAP), who are at higher risk for significant discomfort following treatment. While the combination of ibuprofen and acetaminophen is widely used, limited evidence exists comparing scheduled versus on-demand dosing to combat postoperative pain in this population.
